entries.speaker: Brutish Boy
entries.en: You've always got great grades, dude...[n]Do you like, study at the library or[n]something?

entries.speaker: Refined Boy
entries.en: Not at all. I actually use the diner for[n]such activities.

entries.speaker: Refined Boy
entries.en: It's a surprisingly great place for[n]concentration. You can even eat if[n]you get hungry mid-session.

entries.speaker: Brutish Boy
entries.en: You kidding me? Man, all you rich peeps[n]are so different from the rest of us...

entries.speaker: Brutish Boy
entries.en: I wanna study at a diner too! Oh well,[n]guess I gotta find a part-time job for that...

entries.speaker: Rain-Hating Student
entries.en: I seriously can't stand rainy days...

entries.speaker: Rain-Hating Student
entries.en: My hair gets all out of whack, my clothes[n]get drenched... It makes you want to just[n]stay inside, yeah?

entries.speaker: Rain-Loving Student
entries.en: Really? I love all that stuff.

entries.speaker: Rain-Loving Student
entries.en: It's kinda like, the sound of the rain is[n]calming... I can focus on reading and[n]studying way more.

entries.speaker: Rain-Loving Student
entries.en: Huh? I wasn't expecting a response like[n]that... You sure are weird...

entries.speaker: Anxious Student
entries.en: ...Don't you think all that blackmail[n]stuff is insane?

entries.speaker: Anxious Student
entries.en: I didn't think it had anything to do with[n]me, but there are even victims in my[n]class...

entries.speaker: Fast-Talking Student
entries.en: Oooh, I know all about that! These guys[n]supposedly come asking if you want an[n]easy, high-paying job...

entries.speaker: Fast-Talking Student
entries.en: But then if you say yes, you get dragged[n]into some real shady stuff...

entries.speaker: Fast-Talking Student
entries.en: The teachers or student council prez'll do[n]something about it though. People're real[n]worried.

entries.speaker: Anxious Student
entries.en: Oh, are you talking about that posting?[n]I wonder if she was serious about it...

entries.speaker: Anxious Student
entries.en: I heard she knew about Kamoshida and[n]the sexual harassment... She prolly won't[n]be too much help...
